scope: bounded deterministic logical event scheduling, total tie order and event-budget rejection; no physical clock, interrupt or hard real-time claim; executed via real loopback HTTP, caller-owned embedded instance and two-worker replicated transport; no public deployment/microcontroller/multi-host claim

independentGeneration.requestedToolPolicy: read only named frozen candidates; no other filesystem, memory, network, tools or writes

runtimeControls: observed peer death and replacement replay
authorityProfile: local source/binary-bound target execution, frozen cases and fresh exact independent proposals; no new hosted CI

trials.intent: Sort events by increasing time, then increasing priority value, then increasing identifier, using a total deterministic order.
Reject an advance when the count of due active events exceeds the event budget; equality is allowed.
An external time proposal requires temporal commit capability equal to one and cannot move logical time backwards.
